tEn: LongCat Sparse Attention: Taming the Lightning via Streaming-aware Hierarchical Cross-Layer Indexing
tZh: LongCat 稀疏注意力：通过流感知的层级跨层索引驯服闪电
sEn: LongCat Sparse Attention (LSA) achieves full-attention performance with up to 1M context length via streaming-aware, cross-layer, and hierarchical indexing, enabling efficient long-context training.
sZh: LongCat 稀疏注意力通过流感知、跨层和层级索引，在高达百万级上下文长度下达到与全注意力相当的性能，并支持高效的长上下文训练。
absEn: DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) enables efficient long-context modeling through its Lightning Indexer. However, practical deployment remains constrained by the indexer's expensive $O(L^2)$ scoring overhead and the hardware-inefficient, discontinuous memory-access patterns induced by its outputs. To address these system-level bottlenecks, we introduce LongCat Sparse Attention (LSA), a hardware-algorithm co-designed framework comprising three complementary and orthogonal strategies: (1) Streaming-Aware Indexing, which selectively converts scattered KV entries into hardware-aligned contiguous layouts to enable coalesced HBM access; (2) Cross-Layer Indexing, which amortizes indexing overhead by reusing the results produced by a single layer across consecutive layers, supported by cross-layer distillation; and (3) Hierarchical Indexing, which adopts a coarse-to-fine scoring scheme to progressively narrow the candidate set for each query, thereby substantially reducing indexing computation. Extensive scaling experiments, ranging from 69B-A3B to 560B-A27B models, demonstrate that LSA consistently achieves performance on par with full attention across both general-purpose and long-context benchmarks. Moreover, LSA supports native training with context lengths of up to one million tokens and underpins the development of LongCat-2.0 (1.6T-A48B). To facilitate further research, we also introduce and open-source LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse (69B-A3B), which integrates LSA into LongCat-Flash-Lite and incorporates an updated long-context training corpus.
absZh: DeepSeek 稀疏注意力（DSA）通过其闪电索引器实现了高效的长上下文建模。然而，实际部署仍受限于索引器昂贵的 O(L^2)评分开销以及其输出导致的硬件低效、不连续的内存访问模式。为解决这些系统级瓶颈，我们引入了 LongCat 稀疏注意力（LSA），一种硬件-算法协同设计的框架，包含三个互补且正交的策略：（1）流感知索引，选择性地将分散的 KV 条目转换为硬件对齐的连续布局，以实现合并的 HBM 访问；（2）跨层索引，通过重用单层结果在连续层间摊销索引开销，并辅以跨层蒸馏；（3）层级索引，采用从粗到细的评分方案逐步缩小每个查询的候选集，从而大幅减少索引计算。从 69B-A3B 到 560B-A27B 模型的广泛扩展实验表明，LSA 在通用和长上下文基准上均持续达到与全注意力相当的性能。此外，LSA 支持长达一百万 token 的原生训练，并支撑了 LongCat-2.0（1.6T-A48B）的开发。为促进进一步研究，我们还引入并开源了 LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse（69B-A3B），它将 LSA 集成到 LongCat-Flash-Lite 中，并整合了更新的长上下文训练语料库。

full.sec: 1 Introduction
full.secZh: 1 引言

items.en: Long-context capabilities are increasingly essential for modern large language models (LLMs), underpinning applications such as repository-level agentic coding, long-horizon task execution, and extended reasoning. However, scaling LLMs to long contexts remains fundamentally constrained by the quadratic \(\mathcal{O}(L^{2})\) complexity of standard self-attention, where \(L\) denotes the sequence length. Sparse attention mitigates this bottleneck by restricting each query to a subset of key-value (KV) tokens, but its effectiveness depends critically on selecting the most relevant tokens both accurately and efficiently. DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) addresses this challenge with a dedicated Lightning Indexer, which scores prefix tokens for each query and performs fine-grained, token-level selection. DSA thereby achieves near-lossless quality relative to full attention and has been adopted by production-scale foundation models, including DeepSeek-V3.2 and GLM-5.
items.zh: 长上下文能力对现代大语言模型（LLM）日益关键，支撑着仓库级智能体式编码、长时程任务执行和扩展推理等应用。然而，将 LLM 扩展到长上下文仍从根本上受限于标准自注意力机制的二次复杂度\(\mathcal{O}(L^{2})\)，其中\(L\)表示序列长度。稀疏注意力通过将每个查询限制到键值（KV）令牌的子集来缓解这一瓶颈，但其有效性关键取决于能否准确且高效地选择最相关的令牌。DeepSeek 稀疏注意力（DSA）通过专用的 Lightning 索引器解决了这一挑战，该索引器为每个查询对前缀令牌进行评分，并执行细粒度的令牌级选择。DSA 因此实现了相对于全注意力的近乎无损质量，并已被生产级基础模型采用，包括 DeepSeek-V3.2 和 GLM-5。

items.en: Despite its advantages over full attention at long sequence lengths, DSA still leaves substantial room for efficiency improvement. Each DSA layer sequentially executes two operators: the Lightning Indexer, which scores prefix tokens and selects a budget of \(K\) candidates, and the core sparse attention operator, which attends only to the selected subset. Our profiling reveals two corresponding system-level bottlenecks: Indexer Output Discontiguity and Indexer High Overhead.
items.zh: 尽管在长序列长度下相比全注意力具有优势，DSA 仍留有相当大的效率提升空间。每个 DSA 层顺序执行两个算子：Lightning 索引器（对前缀令牌评分并选择预算为\(K\)的候选）和核心稀疏注意力算子（仅关注所选子集）。我们的性能分析揭示了两个相应的系统级瓶颈：索引器输出不连续性和索引器高开销。

items.en: Indexer Output Discontiguity arises because dynamically selected indices require the core sparse-attention operator to gather KV vectors through scattered, non-coalesced memory accesses. Consequently, despite its modest \(\mathcal{O}(LK)\) computational complexity, the operator becomes severely memory-bound and achieves only \(\sim 4.5\%\) of peak HBM bandwidth on our AI accelerators. Indexer High Overhead, meanwhile, stems from scoring the entire prefix for every query, which retains a quadratic \(\mathcal{O}(L^{2})\) complexity. Although DSA reduces the indexer's constant factors through fewer heads, smaller head dimensions, and FP8 quantization, its quadratic cost increasingly dominates layer latency as the context grows, accounting for up to \(90\%\) of the per-layer latency at a 1024K context length. We characterize both bottlenecks in detail in Section 2.3.
items.zh: 索引器输出不连续性源于动态选择的索引要求核心稀疏注意力算子通过分散的、非合并的内存访问来收集 KV 向量。因此，尽管其计算复杂度仅为\(\mathcal{O}(LK)\)，该算子仍严重受内存限制，在我们的 AI 加速器上仅达到峰值 HBM 带宽的\(\sim 4.5\%\)。与此同时，索引器高开销源于对每个查询的整个前缀进行评分，这保持了二次复杂度\(\mathcal{O}(L^{2})\)。尽管 DSA 通过减少头数、缩小头维度和 FP8 量化降低了索引器的常数因子，但随着上下文增长，其二次成本日益主导层延迟，在 1024K 上下文长度下占每层延迟的\(90\%\)之多。我们在第 2.3 节详细描述了这两个瓶颈。

items.en: To address Indexer Output Discontiguity, we introduce Streaming-Aware Indexing (SI). SI allocates part of the sparse attention budget to predictable and contiguous regions, specifically a fixed attention sink and a local sliding window, while using the remaining budget for dynamic token-level selection. This design is motivated by the streaming patterns observed in full attention. By combining dynamically selected tokens with contiguous local regions, SI improves memory coalescing and restores high HBM throughput without compromising long-context accuracy.
items.zh: 为了解决索引器输出不连续性，我们引入了流感知索引（SI）。SI 将部分稀疏注意力预算分配给可预测且连续的区域，具体为固定的注意力汇聚点和局部滑动窗口，同时将剩余预算用于动态令牌级选择。这一设计受到全注意力中观察到的流模式的启发。通过将动态选择的令牌与连续局部区域相结合，SI 改善了内存合并，恢复了高 HBM 吞吐量，且不影响长上下文准确性。

items.en: To reduce Indexer High Overhead, we introduce two complementary mechanisms: Cross-Layer Indexing (CLI) and Hierarchical Indexing (HI). CLI amortizes indexing computation across model depth. Motivated by the observation that salient tokens are often highly consistent across adjacent layers, CLI partitions consecutive layers into groups of size \(N\). The first layer in each group, termed the owner layer, executes the indexer, while the remaining reuse layers share its selected token set. Naively reusing the owner layer's indices, however, leads to substantial quality degradation. We therefore introduce a cross-layer distillation objective that trains the owner indexer to capture tokens salient to the entire group. This reduces indexing computation to approximately \(1/N\) of that required by standard DSA while preserving model quality.
items.zh: 为了降低索引器高开销，我们引入了两种互补机制：跨层索引（CLI）和分层索引（HI）。CLI 将索引计算分摊到模型深度上。基于显著令牌在相邻层间往往高度一致的观察，CLI 将连续层划分为大小为\(N\)的组。每组中的第一层称为所有者层，执行索引器，而其余重用层共享其选择的令牌集。然而，天真地重用所有者层的索引会导致显著的质量下降。因此，我们引入了跨层蒸馏目标，训练所有者索引器捕获对整个组显著的令牌。这将索引计算减少到标准 DSA 所需的大约\(1/N\)，同时保持模型质量。

items.en: HI reduces the cost of each indexing pass through a coarse-to-fine selection scheme. It first uses block-level representations to retrieve the top- \(M\) candidate pages and then performs fine-grained token scoring only within those pages. This reduces the per-query selection complexity from \(\mathcal{O}(L)\) to \(\mathcal{O}(L/P+MP)\) , where \(P\) denotes the page size. Unlike SI and CLI, which are incorporated during both training and inference, HI is a training-free, plug-and-play module that can be applied directly at inference time.
items.zh: HI 通过一种从粗到细的选择方案降低了每次索引遍历的成本。它首先使用块级表示检索前 \(M\) 个候选页面，然后仅在这些页面内进行细粒度的词元评分。这将每次查询的选择复杂度从 \(\mathcal{O}(L)\) 降低到 \(\mathcal{O}(L/P+MP)\)，其中 \(P\) 表示页面大小。与在训练和推理阶段都集成的 SI 和 CLI 不同，HI 是一个无需训练、即插即用的模块，可直接在推理时应用。

items.en: Together, SI, CLI, and HI form LongCat Sparse Attention (LSA), a co-designed sparse-attention framework whose components target complementary bottlenecks and can be composed seamlessly (Fig. 1). We evaluate LSA at two scales within the LongCat family: LongCat-Flash-Lite (69B-A3B) and LongCat-Flash (560B-A27B). Across both scales, LSA consistently matches full attention on general, reasoning, coding, and long-context benchmarks. Moreover, its substantially improved training efficiency over full MLA enables the training of LongCat-2.0 (1.6T-A48B) with context lengths of up to one million tokens under a limited compute budget.
items.zh: SI、CLI 和 HI 共同构成了 LongCat 稀疏注意力（LSA），这是一个协同设计的稀疏注意力框架，其组件针对互补的瓶颈，并且可以无缝组合（图 1）。我们在 LongCat 系列中的两个规模上评估了 LSA：LongCat-Flash-Lite（69B-A3B）和 LongCat-Flash（560B-A27B）。在这两种规模下，LSA 在通用、推理、编码和长上下文基准测试上均与全注意力持平。此外，与完整的 MLA 相比，其训练效率显著提高，使得在有限算力预算下能够训练上下文长度高达一百万词元的 LongCat-2.0（1.6T-A48B）。

items.en: Building on LSA, we further extend the long-context training of LongCat-Flash-Lite, scaling its native context length to one million tokens. The resulting model, LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse, achieves substantially higher long-context inference efficiency than its dense predecessor while exhibiting stronger agentic capabilities.
items.zh: 在 LSA 的基础上，我们进一步扩展了 LongCat-Flash-Lite 的长上下文训练，将其原生上下文长度扩展到一百万词元。由此产生的模型 LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse 在长上下文推理效率上显著高于其稠密前身，同时展现出更强的智能体能力。

items.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows:
items.zh: 我们的主要贡献总结如下：

items.en: We systematically profile DSA and identify two major efficiency bottlenecks: Indexer Output Discontiguity and Indexer High Overhead (Section 2.3).
items.zh: 我们系统地剖析了 DSA，并识别出两个主要的效率瓶颈：索引器输出不连续性和索引器高开销（第 2.3 节）。

items.en: We propose LSA, which addresses these bottlenecks through three complementary mechanisms: Streaming-Aware Indexing for hardware-friendly memory access, Cross-Layer Indexing for amortizing indexing computation across layers, and Hierarchical Indexing for reducing the token-level scoring cost (Section 3).
items.zh: 我们提出 LSA，它通过三种互补机制解决这些瓶颈：面向硬件友好内存访问的流感知索引（Streaming-Aware Indexing）、跨层索引（Cross-Layer Indexing）以分摊各层的索引计算，以及分层索引（Hierarchical Indexing）以降低词元级评分成本（第 3 节）。

items.en: Through extensive ablation studies, we show that the training-aware SI and CLI mechanisms improve both training and inference efficiency while maintaining performance parity with full attention. The training-free HI module provides further inference speedups with only marginal quality degradation (Sections 5 and 4).
items.zh: 通过广泛的消融研究，我们表明训练感知的 SI 和 CLI 机制在保持与全注意力性能持平的同时，提高了训练和推理效率。免训练的 HI 模块进一步加速推理，仅带来轻微的质量下降（第 5 节和第 4 节）。

items.en: We release LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse, an open-source model built with LSA, to facilitate research and practical deployment of sparse-attention architectures (Section 6).
items.zh: 我们发布了 LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse，一个基于 LSA 构建的开源模型，以促进稀疏注意力架构的研究和实际部署（第 6 节）。

full.sec: 2 Sparse Attention and the DSA Baseline
full.secZh: 2 稀疏注意力与 DSA 基线

items.en: Before presenting our method, we review the evolution of sparse attention, formalize the DSA mechanism that serves as our baseline, and profile its efficiency bottlenecks.
items.zh: 在介绍我们的方法之前，我们先回顾稀疏注意力的发展历程，形式化作为我们基线的 DSA 机制，并分析其效率瓶颈。

full.sec: 2.1 From Fixed Patterns to Retrieval-Based Sparse Attention
full.secZh: 2.1 从固定模式到基于检索的稀疏注意力

items.en: The central challenge in scaling self-attention to long contexts is the quadratic cost \(\mathcal{O}(L^{2})\) in sequence length \(L\) . Sparse attention methods address this by restricting each query to attend only a small subset of key-value positions. These methods differ primarily in how they determine the positions attended by each query. Along this design dimension, approaches have evolved from content-blind fixed patterns to increasingly sophisticated learned retrieval mechanisms.
items.zh: 将自注意力扩展到长上下文的核心挑战在于序列长度 \(L\) 带来的二次复杂度 \(\mathcal{O}(L^{2})\)。稀疏注意力方法通过限制每个查询只关注少量键值位置来解决这一问题。这些方法的主要区别在于如何确定每个查询所关注的位置。在这一设计维度上，方法已从内容无关的固定模式演变为日益复杂的可学习检索机制。

items.en: Fixed patterns. Early sparse attention methods define sparsity structures a priori, such as sliding windows, strided patterns, or designated global tokens . These fixed patterns are hardware-friendly due to their regularity but entirely content-blind: the same positions are attended regardless of input.
items.zh: **固定模式**。早期的稀疏注意力方法先验地定义稀疏结构，如滑动窗口、跨步模式或指定的全局令牌。这些固定模式因其规则性而对硬件友好，但完全与内容无关：无论输入如何，都关注相同的位置。

items.en: Query-aware but non-learnable retrieval. A natural next step is to make the sparsity pattern content-dependent. Reformer applies locality-sensitive hashing (LSH) to route queries and keys into shared buckets, restricting attention to within-bucket pairs. RetrievalAttention builds an approximate nearest-neighbor (ANN) index over stored keys and retrieves relevant KV entries at inference time. In both cases the selection is query-aware, yet the retrieval criterion cannot be directly optimized through training to improve selection quality.
items.zh: **查询感知但不可学习的检索**。自然的下一步是使稀疏模式依赖于内容。Reformer 使用局部敏感哈希（LSH）将查询和键路由到共享桶中，将注意力限制在桶内配对。RetrievalAttention 在存储的键上构建近似最近邻（ANN）索引，并在推理时检索相关的 KV 条目。在这两种情况下，选择是查询感知的，但检索标准无法通过训练直接优化以提高选择质量。

items.en: Coarse-grained learned retrieval. The key leap in recent work is making the retrieval mechanism itself trainable. MoBA and NSA partition the KV sequence into contiguous blocks and learn which blocks are most relevant to each query. Their indexing mechanisms directly reuse the core attention’s query and key representations (after compression): MoBA computes block affinity via mean-pooled keys, while NSA repurposes its compression branch’s attention scores as block importance signals. However, these block-level methods inherently blur token-level importance distinctions within each block, leading to possibly suboptimal performance relative to full attention on some long-context and reasoning tasks.
items.zh: **粗粒度可学习检索**。近期工作的关键飞跃是使检索机制本身可训练。MoBA 和 NSA 将 KV 序列划分为连续的块，并学习哪些块与每个查询最相关。它们的索引机制直接重用核心注意力的查询和键表示（压缩后）：MoBA 通过均值池化键计算块亲和力，而 NSA 则将其压缩分支的注意力分数重新用作块重要性信号。然而，这些块级方法固有地模糊了块内令牌级的重要性差异，导致在某些长上下文和推理任务上相对于全注意力的性能可能次优。

items.en: Fine-grained learned retrieval. DSA advances to token-level fine-grained learned sparse attention, scoring every individual token in the prefix for each query. Unlike MoBA and NSA which directly reuse the core attention’s representations for scoring, DSA introduces a dedicated Lightning Indexer with its own query and key projections, whose inputs are detached from the model’s computation graph during training. This fine-grained indexing combined with the indexer’s architectural independence enables DSA to achieve near-lossless performance relative to full attention. DSA has since been adopted by multiple production systems including DeepSeek-V3.2 and GLM-5 , validating its deployability at scale.
items.zh: **细粒度可学习检索**。DSA 推进到令牌级细粒度可学习稀疏注意力，为每个查询对前缀中的每个单独令牌进行评分。与直接重用核心注意力表示进行评分的 MoBA 和 NSA 不同，DSA 引入了一个专用的 Lightning Indexer，具有自己的查询和键投影，其输入在训练期间与模型的计算图分离。这种细粒度索引与索引器的架构独立性相结合，使 DSA 能够实现相对于全注意力几乎无损的性能。此后，DSA 已被多个生产系统采用，包括 DeepSeek-V3.2 和 GLM-5，验证了其在大规模部署中的可行性。

The indexer parameters are updated by this KL loss, while its input is detached from the model’s computation graph so that the indexer’s gradients do not perturb the base model. The base model parameters are updated solely via the next-token prediction loss.

items.en: The indexer is designed to be lightweight relative to the core attention. It uses fewer heads (typically half that of the core attention) and a smaller head dimension (roughly one-third, since the indexer’s nope dimension is much smaller than MLA’s absorbed latent dimension). It further supports FP8 computation. These choices collectively minimize the per-token cost of indexing, justifying the “Lightning” designation.
items.zh: 索引器被设计为相对于核心注意力机制轻量级。它使用较少的头（通常为核心注意力的一半）和较小的头维度（大约三分之一，因为索引器的 nope 维度远小于 MLA 的吸收潜在维度）。它还支持 FP8 计算。这些选择共同最小化了索引的每词元成本，证明了“闪电”名称的合理性。

items.en: The overall computational cost of DSA consists of indexer scoring \(\mathcal{O}(L^{2})\) and sparse attention \(\mathcal{O}(LK)\) . Despite its low per-token cost, the indexer scales quadratically with \(L\) . Consequently, for sufficiently long sequences, the indexer becomes the dominant bottleneck and can incur greater computational cost than the core attention operation it is designed to serve. We quantify this crossover through systematic profiling in the next section.
items.zh: DSA 的总计算成本包括索引器评分 \(\mathcal{O}(L^{2})\) 和稀疏注意力 \(\mathcal{O}(LK)\) 。尽管其每词元成本较低，但索引器随 \(L\) 二次方扩展。因此，对于足够长的序列，索引器成为主要瓶颈，可能比其服务的核心注意力操作产生更高的计算成本。我们在下一节中通过系统剖析来量化这种交叉点。

full.sec: 2.3 Profiling the Efficiency Bottlenecks of DSA
full.secZh: 2.3 DSA 效率瓶颈分析

items.en: The execution cost of a DSA layer is partitioned between two primary operators whose latencies scale differentially with respect to the KV length \(L\) . For each incoming query token, the Lightning Indexer (LI) must evaluate all \(L\) prefix keys, resulting in a linear complexity ( \(\mathcal{O}(L)\) ). Conversely, the Sparse Flash Attention (SFA) restricts its attention to a fixed set of \(K\) selected tokens, thereby remaining essentially decoupled from \(L\) . This divergence creates a clear regime shift: SFA dominates computational overhead in short contexts, while LI takes over at extended sequence lengths, intersecting at approximately \({\sim}100\) K tokens. This breakdown during the decoding stage is quantified in Table 1 for KV lengths ranging from 4K to 1024K. These regimes reveal two intrinsic efficiency bottlenecks in DSA's sparse selection mechanism: Indexer Output Discontiguity and Indexer High Overhead. We examine both bottlenecks in detail below.
items.zh: DSA 层的执行成本由两个主要算子分担，它们的延迟随 KV 长度 \(L\) 的变化呈不同比例。对于每个传入的查询词元，Lightning Indexer（LI）必须评估所有 \(L\) 个前缀键，导致线性复杂度（\(\mathcal{O}(L)\)）。相反，Sparse Flash Attention（SFA）将其注意力限制在固定的 \(K\) 个选定词元上，因此基本上与 \(L\) 解耦。这种差异造成了明显的阶段转换：在短上下文中，SFA 主导计算开销；而在长序列中，LI 接管，两者在大约 \({\sim}100\)K 词元处相交。解码阶段的这种分解在表 1 中针对 KV 长度从 4K 到 1024K 进行了量化。这些阶段揭示了 DSA 稀疏选择机制中的两个内在效率瓶颈：索引器输出不连续性和索引器高开销。下面我们详细考察这两个瓶颈。

items.en: Token-level sparse selection forces each memory transaction to retrieve a single, non-contiguous KV vector, severely degrading High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) utilization. On our AI accelerators, a single core can sustain approximately \(50\) in-flight cachelines ( \(512\) B each) under ideal memory coalescing, maintaining a memory window of \({\sim}25.6\) KB. In DSA, however, each selected token is fetched via an independent gather of a single latent KV vector ( \(1{,}152\) B in BF16), which spans only \(3\) cachelines. Consequently, two inefficiencies compound: first, this gather occupies merely \(3\) of the \({\sim}50\) outstanding memory slots (yielding \(\approx 6\%\) memory-level parallelism); second, even within these \(3\) cachelines, data packing efficiency is only \(\approx 75\%\) . The resulting net effective bandwidth thus plummets to a mere \(\approx\mathbf{4.5\%}\) ( \(\approx 1/22\) ) of peak performance.
items.zh: 词元级稀疏选择迫使每次内存事务检索单个非连续的 KV 向量，严重降低了高带宽内存（HBM）的利用率。在我们的 AI 加速器上，在理想的内存合并下，单个核心可以维持大约 \(50\) 个在途缓存行（每个 \(512\) B），保持 \({\sim}25.6\) KB 的内存窗口。然而，在 DSA 中，每个选定的词元通过独立收集单个潜在 KV 向量（BF16 中为 \(1{,}152\) B）来获取，该向量仅跨越 \(3\) 个缓存行。因此，两种低效叠加：首先，这种收集仅占用 \({\sim}50\) 个未完成内存槽中的 \(3\) 个（产生 \(\approx 6\%\) 的内存级并行度）；其次，即使在这 \(3\) 个缓存行内，数据打包效率也只有 \(\approx 75\%\) 。由此产生的净有效带宽因此骤降至峰值性能的 \(\approx\mathbf{4.5\%}\)（\(\approx 1/22\)）。

items.en: While the aforementioned analysis focuses on the forward pass during inference, this output discontiguity inflicts a more severe performance penalty during training. In the backward pass, gradient updates rely on scatter_add operations over the identical non-contiguous token indices. Due to the scattered nature and input-dependent selection of these indices, independent computing cores frequently attempt to write to overlapping KV gradient regions in HBM. When different cores concurrently target identical gradient positions, these probabilistic write conflicts force the HBM transactions to serialize, severely degrading hardware concurrency. The indexer backward pass suffers from this same cross-core serialization as it scatters gradients across all \(L\) scored positions.
items.zh: 虽然上述分析侧重于推理期间的前向传播，但这种输出不连续性在训练期间会造成更严重的性能损失。在反向传播中，梯度更新依赖于对相同非连续词元索引的 scatter_add 操作。由于这些索引的分散性和输入依赖性，独立的计算核心经常尝试写入 HBM 中重叠的 KV 梯度区域。当不同核心同时针对相同的梯度位置时，这些概率性的写冲突迫使 HBM 事务串行化，严重降低了硬件并发性。索引器的反向传播也遭受同样的跨核心串行化，因为它将梯度分散到所有 \(L\) 个评分位置。

items.en: Consider long-context decoding, where a fixed number of query tokens attends to a KV cache whose length \(L\) grows continuously. The computational cost of the LI scales linearly with \(L\) for each query because both of its internal stages operate over the entire context. Specifically, the scoring stage performs an MQA-style QK matrix multiplication with \(\mathcal{O}(L)\) complexity, after which Top- \(K\) selection incurs an additional \(\mathcal{O}(L)\) cost over all candidate scores. By contrast, SFA attends to a fixed budget of \(K\) selected tokens, making its decoding cost independent of \(L\) .
items.zh: 考虑长上下文解码，其中固定数量的查询词元关注 KV 缓存，其长度 \(L\) 持续增长。LI 的计算成本随每个查询的 \(L\) 线性增长，因为其两个内部阶段都操作于整个上下文。具体来说，评分阶段执行 MQA 风格的 QK 矩阵乘法，复杂度为 \(\mathcal{O}(L)\)，之后 Top-\(K\) 选择在所有候选分数上产生额外的 \(\mathcal{O}(L)\) 成本。相比之下，SFA 关注固定的 \(K\) 个选定词元预算，使其解码成本与 \(L\) 无关。

items.en: This asymmetry explains the latency breakdown reported in Table 1. As the context length increases from 4K to 1024K, SFA latency remains nearly constant at \({\sim}0.10\) ms, whereas LI latency increases by \(27\times\) , from \(0.034\) ms to \(0.930\) ms. The dominant per-layer bottleneck therefore shifts from SFA at short context lengths to LI at long context lengths. At a 1024K context length, the indexer accounts for up to \(90\%\) of the total per-layer latency. Moreover, although LI has linear complexity per decoding query, applying it to every query during prefill or training results in an aggregate \(\mathcal{O}(L^{2})\) indexing cost, fundamentally limiting the scalability of standard DSA.
items.zh: 这种不对称性解释了表 1 中报告的延迟分解。随着上下文长度从 4K 增加到 1024K，SFA 延迟几乎保持不变，约为 \({\sim}0.10\) ms，而 LI 延迟增加了 \(27\times\)，从 \(0.034\) ms 增加到 \(0.930\) ms。因此，每层的主要瓶颈从短上下文长度下的 SFA 转变为长上下文长度下的 LI。在 1024K 上下文长度下，索引器占每层总延迟的 \(90\%\) 以上。此外，尽管 LI 对每个解码查询具有线性复杂度，但在预填充或训练期间将其应用于每个查询会导致总索引成本为 \(\mathcal{O}(L^{2})\)，从根本上限制了标准 DSA 的可扩展性。

full.sec: 3 LongCat Sparse Attention (LSA)
full.secZh: 3 LongCat 稀疏注意力（LSA）

items.en: Building upon the DSA baseline formalized in Section 2.2, LSA introduces three orthogonal efficiency improvements to the indexer: Streaming-Aware Indexing (SI; Section 3.1), Cross-Layer Indexing (CLI; Section 3.2), and Hierarchical Indexing (HI; Section 3.3). Each module targets a distinct bottleneck dimension identified in Section 2.3 and can compose naturally with the others. We describe each component in detail in the remainder of this section.
items.zh: 在 2.2 节形式化的 DSA 基线基础上，LSA 为索引器引入了三个正交的效率改进：流感知索引（SI；3.1 节）、跨层索引（CLI；3.2 节）和分层索引（HI；3.3 节）。每个模块针对 2.3 节中识别出的不同瓶颈维度，并能与其他模块自然组合。我们在本节其余部分详细描述每个组件。

full.sec: 3.1 Streaming-Aware Indexing: Improving Locality for Hardware-Aligned Coalesced Access
full.secZh: 3.1 流式感知索引：面向硬件对齐的合并访问优化局部性

items.en: StreamingLLM reveals that a small number of initial tokens act as attention sinks and absorb a disproportionate amount of attention weight because of softmax normalization constraints. It further demonstrates that retaining only these sink tokens together with a local sliding window is sufficient to maintain stable perplexity during streaming inference. DuoAttention further deepens this finding by showing that attention heads exhibit clear functional specialization: Streaming Heads primarily attend to sinks and recent tokens (capturing local context and numerical stability), while Retrieval Heads are responsible for long-range information retrieval.
items.zh: StreamingLLM 揭示，由于 softmax 归一化的约束，少量初始词元充当注意力汇聚点（attention sinks），吸收了不成比例的注意力权重。该研究进一步表明，仅保留这些汇聚词元以及一个局部滑动窗口，就足以在流式推理中维持稳定的困惑度。DuoAttention 进一步深化了这一发现，表明注意力头表现出明确的功能特化：流式头（Streaming Heads）主要关注汇聚词元和近期词元（捕获局部上下文和数值稳定性），而检索头（Retrieval Heads）则负责长距离信息检索。

items.en: Departing from head-wise classification, we analyze the aggregate attention mass distribution across all heads. Our empirical analysis reveals a persistent streaming pattern: the sink and sliding window regions consistently capture a substantial share of the attention weight (see Fig. 2). Recognizing this as a stable structural feature, we formalize their allocation as a deterministic budget. This approach allows us to partition the attention operation into a hardware-aligned fixed streaming component (sink and sliding window) and a dynamic sparse component. Formally, we decompose the attended token set into three disjoint subsets:
items.zh: 不同于按头分类的方法，我们分析了所有注意力头的总体注意力质量分布。我们的实证分析揭示了一种持续的流式模式：汇聚区域和滑动窗口区域始终占据注意力权重的很大份额（见图 2）。我们将其视为一种稳定的结构特征，并将其分配形式化为确定性预算。这种方法使我们能够将注意力操作划分为硬件对齐的固定流式组件（汇聚和滑动窗口）和动态稀疏组件。形式上，我们将被关注的词元集合分解为三个不相交的子集：

Specifically, \(\mathcal{S}_{\text{sink}}=\{1,\ldots,K_{\text{sink}}\}\) covers the sink region, \(\mathcal{S}_{\text{swa}}=\{t-K_{\text{swa}}+1,\ldots,t\}\) is a sliding window around the query, and \(\mathcal{S}_{\text{sparse}}\) contains the remaining \(K_{\text{sparse}}\) tokens dynamically selected by the indexer from the non-fixed positions. The indexer’s scoring range correspondingly shrinks:

items.en: Under the standard two-stage training (Section 2.2), the dense warm-up stage requires no modification: the indexer is supervised against the full-sequence attention distribution (Eq. 4). In the sparse training stage, the distillation target becomes the attention distribution renormalized over the selected subset \(\mathcal{S}_{t}\) . Although at inference time the indexer only scores tokens in the middle region ( \(s\notin\mathcal{S}_{\text{sink}}\cup\mathcal{S}_{\text{swa}}\) ), during training we deliberately distill the indexer over the entire selected set, including the sink and SWA portions. Since these streaming regions capture a substantial fraction of the attention mass (Fig. 2), including them in the distillation target provides richer supervisory signal and enables the indexer to more thoroughly learn the overall attention structure, improving its ability to identify the most relevant tokens in the remaining middle region.
items.zh: 在标准的两阶段训练（第 2.2 节）下，密集预热阶段无需修改：索引器以全序列注意力分布（式 4）为监督目标。在稀疏训练阶段，蒸馏目标变为在选定子集 \(\mathcal{S}_{t}\) 上重新归一化的注意力分布。虽然在推理时索引器仅对中间区域（ \(s\notin\mathcal{S}_{\text{sink}}\cup\mathcal{S}_{\text{swa}}\) ）的词元进行评分，但在训练期间我们刻意在整个选定集合上蒸馏索引器，包括汇聚和滑动窗口部分。由于这些流式区域捕获了注意力质量的很大一部分（图 2），将它们纳入蒸馏目标可提供更丰富的监督信号，使索引器能够更彻底地学习整体注意力结构，从而提高其在剩余中间区域识别最相关词元的能力。

items.en: We set sink size \(K_{\text{sink}}=16\) and sliding window size \(K_{\text{swa}}=1024\) , yielding a fixed-to-sparse budget ratio of approximately 1:1 (determined by ablation, see Section 5.3), which makes roughly 50% of the selected tokens reside in contiguous memory regions. This partitioning yields three benefits: (a) the sink and sliding-window portions are accessed as contiguous blocks, enabling efficient coalesced HBM reads; (b) the indexer’s effective scoring range shrinks from \(L\) to \(L-K_{\text{sink}}-K_{\text{swa}}\) , modestly reducing computation; and (c) the deterministic structure provides a natural interface for KV cache offloading and speculative decoding, where consecutive decode steps share predictable cache regions.
items.zh: 我们设置汇聚大小 \(K_{\text{sink}}=16\) 和滑动窗口大小 \(K_{\text{swa}}=1024\) ，得到固定与稀疏预算比约为 1:1（通过消融实验确定，见第 5.3 节），这使得大约 50% 的选定词元位于连续内存区域。这种划分带来三个好处：(a) 汇聚和滑动窗口部分作为连续块访问，实现高效的合并 HBM 读取；(b) 索引器的有效评分范围从 \(L\) 缩小到 \(L-K_{\text{sink}}-K_{\text{swa}}\) ，适度减少计算量；(c) 确定性结构为 KV 缓存卸载和推测解码提供了自然接口，其中连续的解码步骤共享可预测的缓存区域。

full.sec: 3.2 Cross-Layer Indexing: Amortizing Indexing Overhead via Inter-layer Pattern Redundancy
full.secZh: 3.2 跨层索引：通过层间模式冗余摊销索引开销

items.en: Recent studies have shown that the set of salient tokens, defined as those receiving the highest attention mass, remains remarkably stable across consecutive Transformer layers. This observation has motivated a family of sparse attention methods that exploit cross-layer stability to avoid repeatedly selecting salient tokens in each layer. These methods typically designate a few full-attention layers as oracles to identify important tokens and let remaining sparse layers reuse their selections. A natural question arises: does DSA's Lightning Indexer at a given layer have the capacity to identify the shared salient tokens across itself and subsequent layers?
items.zh: 近期研究表明，显著词元（即获得最高注意力权重的词元）的集合在连续的 Transformer 层之间保持高度稳定。这一观察催生了一系列稀疏注意力方法，它们利用跨层稳定性来避免在每一层重复选择显著词元。这些方法通常指定少数全注意力层作为“预言机”来识别重要词元，并让其余稀疏层复用其选择。一个自然的问题随之而来：DSA 的 Lightning Indexer 在给定层是否具备识别自身及后续层共享显著词元的能力？

items.capEn: Figure 3: Cross-layer Top-KK index analysis on full-attention LongCat-Flash-Lite (69B-A3B). Each layer independently selects its Top-KK tokens from the full attention distribution. Only the upper triangle is shown in (a) and (b), corresponding to the CLI reuse direction, where an earlier source laye

items.en: We verify this on LongCat-Flash-Lite by letting each layer independently run its own indexer and measuring cross-layer agreement (Fig. 3). Adjacent layers share 57.4% of their Top-K budget on average. Despite this partial overlap, reusing an adjacent layer's index set still captures 93.2% of the target layer's attention mass. This cross-layer consistency opens up the possibility of reusing indexer outputs across layers.
items.zh: 我们在 LongCat-Flash-Lite 上对此进行了验证，方法是让每一层独立运行自己的索引器，并测量跨层一致性（图 3）。相邻层平均共享其 Top-K 预算的 57.4%。尽管存在部分重叠，复用相邻层的索引集仍能捕获目标层 93.2% 的注意力质量。这种跨层一致性为跨层复用索引器输出提供了可能。

items.en: We partition consecutive layers into CLI groups of size N. Only the first layer in each group executes the indexer; the subsequent N-1 layers directly reuse the index set S_t produced by the first layer, reducing the total number of indexing passes from L_layers to L_layers/N. Naively reusing indices without training adaptation degrades performance (Section 5.3), because each indexer is originally trained to predict saliency only for its own layer. To enable faithful cross-layer reuse, we make a minimal modification to the standard DSA distillation loss (Eq. 4): instead of supervising each indexer against only its own layer's attention, the indexer at the first layer of each group is trained to predict the attention patterns of all layers within the group:
items.zh: 我们将连续层划分为大小为 N 的 CLI 组。每组仅第一层执行索引器；后续 N-1 层直接复用第一层产生的索引集 S_t，从而将索引传递的总次数从 L_layers 减少到 L_layers/N。若不做训练适配而直接复用索引，性能会下降（见第 5.3 节），因为每个索引器原本仅针对自身层训练以预测显著性。为了实现可靠的跨层复用，我们对标准 DSA 蒸馏损失（式 4）进行了最小修改：不再让每个索引器仅针对自身层的注意力进行监督，而是让每组第一层的索引器训练为预测组内所有层的注意力模式：

items.en: where l is the first layer in the group, N is the group size, and L_I^{(l+i)} is the indexer distillation loss that supervises the shared indexer output against the attention distribution of layer l+i. Note that this cross-layer distillation applies to both the dense warm-up and sparse training stages. At inference time, the shared indexer runs once and broadcasts the resulting index set to all layers in the group.
items.zh: 其中 l 是组内第一层，N 是组大小，L_I^{(l+i)} 是索引器蒸馏损失，用于将共享索引器的输出与第 l+i 层的注意力分布进行监督。注意，这种跨层蒸馏同时应用于密集预热和稀疏训练阶段。在推理时，共享索引器运行一次，并将所得索引集广播给组内所有层。

items.en: Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) appends D sequential prediction steps (each a Transformer layer with its own attention) after the main model to predict D additional future tokens, where each step combines the previous step's representation with the next token's embedding. We extend CLI to the MTP dimension: all D MTP steps form their own independent CLI group (separate from the main model's groups) and share a single index set produced by the first MTP step's indexer, trained via cross-layer distillation: L_CLI^{MTP} = sum_{k=1}^{D} L_I^{(MTP_k)}. Unlike CLI in the main model, where adjacent layers process the same input and naturally exhibit correlated saliency patterns, MTP steps operate sequentially. Each step attends to representations that incorporate different future token embeddings, which may make index reuse across MTP steps appear less justified. However, the cross-layer distillation loss ensures that the shared indexer produces a selection jointly optimized for all MTP steps. At inference time, the first MTP step's indexer has already been trained to account for the attention patterns of subsequent steps, making CLI reuse across MTP steps equally well-founded. Ablation experiments (Section 5.3) confirm that this approach maintains quality parity with independent per-step indexing.
items.zh: 多词元预测（MTP）在主模型之后附加 D 个顺序预测步骤（每个步骤是一个具有自身注意力的 Transformer 层），以预测 D 个额外的未来词元，其中每个步骤将前一步的表示与下一个词元的嵌入相结合。我们将 CLI 扩展到 MTP 维度：所有 D 个 MTP 步骤构成一个独立的 CLI 组（与主模型的组分开），并共享由第一个 MTP 步骤的索引器产生的单一索引集，该索引器通过跨层蒸馏训练：L_CLI^{MTP} = sum_{k=1}^{D} L_I^{(MTP_k)}。与主模型中的 CLI 不同（相邻层处理相同输入，自然表现出相关的显著性模式），MTP 步骤是顺序操作的。每个步骤关注的是包含不同未来词元嵌入的表示，这可能使跨 MTP 步骤的索引复用看起来不太合理。然而，跨层蒸馏损失确保共享索引器产生针对所有 MTP 步骤联合优化的选择。在推理时，第一个 MTP 步骤的索引器已经训练为考虑后续步骤的注意力模式，使得跨 MTP 步骤的 CLI 复用同样有充分依据。消融实验（第 5.3 节）证实，该方法与独立逐步骤索引在质量上保持持平。

items.en: Although our analysis reveals that certain layers can sustain high attention mass coverage even with large reuse depths (Fig. 3c), practical LLM architecture design favors simplicity and uniform structure for robust scaling across model sizes. We therefore adopt a uniform interleave pattern with a fixed group size \(N\) across all layers. We further constrain \(N\) to be even for two reasons: (1) the LongCat-Flash-Lite series adopts a shortcut-connected architecture where each shortcut layer contains two serial attention operations, and (2) even group sizes ensure uniform partitioning across pipeline-parallel stages during training. From Fig. 3(c), we observe that the minimum coverage across layer pairs begins to drop noticeably when the reuse distance exceeds 4. Ablation experiments (Section 5.3) show that \(N=4\) incurs measurable accuracy loss on long-context validation, so we set \(N=2\), which halves the indexing compute with no measurable quality loss. For MTP steps, since they serve as draft proposers for speculative decoding whose outputs are verified by the main model, their accuracy does not affect final generation quality. We therefore let all 3 MTP steps share a single index (i.e., \(N=3\)) to maximize the efficiency gain.
items.zh: 尽管我们的分析表明，即使重用深度较大，某些层也能维持较高的注意力质量覆盖率（图 3c），但实际的 LLM 架构设计倾向于简单和统一的结构，以便在不同模型规模上稳健扩展。因此，我们在所有层采用固定的组大小\(N\)的统一交错模式。我们进一步将\(N\)限制为偶数，原因有二：（1）LongCat-Flash-Lite 系列采用捷径连接架构，每个捷径层包含两个串行注意力操作；（2）偶数分组大小确保训练期间流水线并行阶段的均匀划分。从图 3(c)中，我们观察到当重用距离超过 4 时，层对间的最小覆盖率开始明显下降。消融实验（第 5.3 节）表明，\(N=4\)在长上下文验证中会导致可测量的精度损失，因此我们设置\(N=2\)，这使索引计算减半且没有可测量的质量损失。对于 MTP 步骤，由于它们作为推测解码的草稿提议者，其输出由主模型验证，因此它们的精度不影响最终生成质量。因此，我们让所有 3 个 MTP 步骤共享一个索引（即\(N=3\)），以最大化效率增益。

items.en: After our CLI strategy was validated and deployed in production, we became aware of IndexCache, an independent and concurrent effort that arrives at a highly similar training-aware cross-layer distillation mechanism for index reuse. Despite the shared core idea, several differences are worth noting. (1) Architecture: we validate on LongCat-Flash-Lite's shortcut-connected structure (two serial attention operations per shortcut layer), whereas IndexCache targets a standard Transformer layout. (2) Effective reuse ratio: IndexCache reports that 1/4 indexer retention (i.e., \(N=4\)) remains within 0.4% of baseline on their evaluation benchmarks, whereas our ablations (Section 5.3) show that \(N=4\) incurs measurable accuracy loss on long-context validation, leading us to adopt the more conservative \(N=2\). This discrepancy might stem from the differences in model architecture and context length noted above. (3) Composability: beyond validating CLI in isolation, we demonstrate that it composes effectively with the other two LSA components (Streaming-aware and Hierarchical Indexing), achieving greater aggregate speedup than any single strategy alone. (4) Multi-Token Prediction: we further verify that CLI remains effective across MTP steps, extending index reuse to the speculative decoding path.
items.zh: 在我们的 CLI 策略经过验证并投入生产后，我们了解到 IndexCache，这是一个独立且并行的努力，它提出了一个高度相似的训练感知跨层蒸馏机制用于索引重用。尽管核心思想相同，但有几个差异值得注意。（1）架构：我们在 LongCat-Flash-Lite 的捷径连接结构（每个捷径层有两个串行注意力操作）上验证，而 IndexCache 针对标准 Transformer 布局。（2）有效重用比率：IndexCache 报告在其评估基准上，1/4 索引器保留（即\(N=4\)）与基线相差在 0.4%以内，而我们的消融实验（第 5.3 节）表明\(N=4\)在长上下文验证中会导致可测量的精度损失，因此我们采用了更保守的\(N=2\)。这种差异可能源于上述模型架构和上下文长度的差异。（3）可组合性：除了单独验证 CLI 外，我们还证明它能与其他两个 LSA 组件（流感知和分层索引）有效组合，实现比任何单一策略更大的总体加速。（4）多词预测：我们进一步验证 CLI 在 MTP 步骤中仍然有效，将索引重用扩展到推测解码路径。

items.en: The indexer scores every token in the non-fixed region for each query, yielding \(\mathcal{O}(L)\) per-query cost that dominates latency at long contexts. Can we eliminate most irrelevant tokens cheaply before invoking fine-grained scoring? Our solution is a two-stage coarse-to-fine scoring scheme: a cheap coarse stage first recalls a small subset of candidate sub-sequences, shrinking the candidate set on which the expensive fine-grained scoring is then performed.
items.zh: 索引器对非固定区域中的每个词元进行评分，每个查询产生 \(\mathcal{O}(L)\) 的代价，这在长上下文下主导了延迟。我们能否在调用细粒度评分之前廉价地消除大多数不相关的词元？我们的解决方案是一个两阶段的由粗到细的评分方案：一个廉价的粗阶段首先召回一小部分候选子序列，缩小了随后进行昂贵细粒度评分的候选集。

Under this measure, the two Top-K operations in Eqs. 10 and 12 cost \(\mathcal{O}(L/P)\) over pages and \(\mathcal{O}(M\cdot P)\) over the recalled tokens, respectively, reducing the original \(\mathcal{O}(L)\) per-query selection to \(\mathcal{O}(L/P+M\cdot P)\).

items.en: Hierarchical Indexing is training-free: it requires no additional parameters or fine-tuning, operating purely as an inference-time optimization over the existing indexer. The mean value of the blocks is precomputed once per sequence and stored in a cache.
items.zh: 层次索引无需训练：它不需要额外的参数或微调，纯粹作为对现有索引器的推理时优化运行。块的均值在每序列中预先计算一次并存储在缓存中。

items.en: We fix the page size \(P\) to 128, while treating the sub-block size \(B\) and candidate count \(M\) as tunable hyperparameters. The ablation study in Section 5.3.5 identifies \(B=8\) and \(M=1024\) as the optimal configuration. Profiling under this setting (Table 4) reveals that the two-stage design introduces non-negligible overhead from block-mean maintenance, coarse-grained scoring, and candidate gathering. As a result, Hierarchical Indexing provides net efficiency gains only for sequence lengths of \(\geq 256\)K, and we enable it adaptively beyond this crossover point.
items.zh: 我们将页面大小 \(P\) 固定为 128，而将子块大小 \(B\) 和候选数量 \(M\) 视为可调超参数。第 5.3.5 节的消融研究确定 \(B=8\) 和 \(M=1024\) 为最优配置。在此设置下的性能分析（表 4）表明，两阶段设计引入了来自块均值维护、粗粒度评分和候选收集的不可忽略的开销。因此，层次索引仅在序列长度 \(\geq 256\)K 时提供净效率提升，我们在此交叉点之后自适应地启用它。

full.sec: 4.1 Efficient Kernel Design and Implementation
full.secZh: 4.1 高效内核设计与实现

items.en: Among the three components of LSA, CLI reuses the indexer across layers and therefore requires no kernel-level modification. This section thus focuses on the kernel design of SI and HI, which reshape the DSA layer at the operator level to address the bottlenecks identified in Section 2.3.
items.zh: 在 LSA 的三个组件中，CLI 跨层复用索引器，因此无需内核级修改。因此，本节重点讨论 SI 和 HI 的内核设计，它们在算子层面重塑 DSA 层，以解决第 2.3 节中识别的瓶颈。

full.sec: 4.1.1 Hybrid Sparse Attention Operator for SI: Partitioning and Overlapped Execution
full.secZh: 4.1.1 面向空间智能的混合稀疏注意力算子：划分与重叠执行

items.en: Recall that SI partitions the attention budget into two components of approximately equal size—a sliding window \(\mathcal{S}_{\text{swa}}\) and a dynamic sparse selection \(\mathcal{S}_{\text{sparse}}\) (plus a small sink \(\mathcal{S}_{\text{sink}}\) of only \(16\) tokens, which we omit in the analysis below for brevity). To translate this algorithmic partitioning into tangible hardware efficiency gains, we design an integrated operator, Hybrid Sparse Attention (HFA).
items.zh: 回顾一下，SI 将注意力预算划分为两个大致相等的部分：滑动窗口 \(\mathcal{S}_{\text{swa}}\) 和动态稀疏选择 \(\mathcal{S}_{\text{sparse}}\)（外加一个仅包含 \(16\) 个 token 的小型 sink \(\mathcal{S}_{\text{sink}}\)，为简洁起见，我们在下文中省略它）。为了将这种算法划分转化为实际的硬件效率提升，我们设计了一个集成算子：混合稀疏注意力（HFA）。

items.en: In the forward pass, instead of processing the entire attention budget with a single SFA operator, HFA decomposes core attention into an SFA operator over \(\mathcal{S}_{\text{sparse}}\) and an SWA operator over \(\mathcal{S}_{\text{swa}}\) . The two operators are dispatched to separate non-blocking hardware streams for overlapped execution, and their partial outputs are merged through online-softmax rescaling.
items.zh: 在前向传播中，HFA 不是用单个 SFA 算子处理整个注意力预算，而是将核心注意力分解为：在 \(\mathcal{S}_{\text{sparse}}\) 上的 SFA 算子和在 \(\mathcal{S}_{\text{swa}}\) 上的 SWA 算子。这两个算子被分派到独立的非阻塞硬件流上以重叠执行，它们的部分输出通过在线 softmax 重缩放合并。

items.en: In the backward pass, beyond confronting non-coalesced memory access issues similar to those in the forward pass, HFA encounters a unique and more severe bottleneck during gradient accumulation. Specifically, gradient updates in the SFA backward pass are performed by allocating a gradient buffer for the entire sequence length in High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) and executing a scatter_add operation over the selected sparse index set. This process constitutes the dominant execution cost of the backward pass. Beyond the low memory bandwidth utilization caused by discontinuous reads, it introduces a severe write-conflict bottleneck: when different processing cores select overlapping indices, they must write to the same physical memory addresses in HBM, resulting in serialized writes to shared cachelines that heavily restrict throughput. By assigning roughly half of the fixed attention budget to the sliding window \(\mathcal{S}_{\text{swa}}\) , HFA correspondingly reduces the active sparse index set, thereby decreasing the number of discrete gather/scatter operations and lowering the probability of write conflicts during gradient accumulation.
items.zh: 在后向传播中，除了要面对与前向传播类似的非合并内存访问问题外，HFA 在梯度累积过程中还遇到了一个独特且更严重的瓶颈。具体来说，SFA 后向传播中的梯度更新是通过在高带宽内存（HBM）中为整个序列长度分配梯度缓冲区，并对选定的稀疏索引集执行 scatter_add 操作来完成的。这一过程构成了后向传播的主要执行成本。除了不连续读取导致的低内存带宽利用率外，它还引入了严重的写冲突瓶颈：当不同的处理核心选择重叠的索引时，它们必须写入 HBM 中的相同物理内存地址，导致对共享缓存行的串行写入，严重限制了吞吐量。通过将固定注意力预算的大约一半分配给滑动窗口 \(\mathcal{S}_{\text{swa}}\)，HFA 相应地减少了活跃的稀疏索引集，从而减少了离散的 gather/scatter 操作数量，并降低了梯度累积期间写冲突的概率。

full.sec: 4.1.2 Index-Selection Operator for HI: Two-Stage Coarse-to-Fine Selection
full.secZh: 4.1.2 用于 HI 的索引选择算子：两阶段由粗到精的选择

items.en: Within the indexing computation, the main bottleneck is not score computation (Eq. 1) but Top-K selection (Eq. 2). Score computation benefits from high-throughput matrix processing units, whereas Top-K requires sorting the full candidate set on much slower vector processing units. To overcome the latency bottleneck caused by global Top-K selection in long-context regimes, we implement a custom operator for the Hierarchical Indexer (HI) formulated in Section 3.3. We then profile the execution latency of this proposed two-stage indexer (Stage 1 coarse page recall followed by Stage 2 fine-grained token selection) against the flat Lightning Indexer (LI) baseline in Table 4.
items.zh: 在索引计算中，主要瓶颈并非得分计算（式 1），而是 Top-K 选择（式 2）。得分计算受益于高吞吐量的矩阵处理单元，而 Top-K 选择需要在速度慢得多的向量处理单元上对完整候选集进行排序。为了克服长上下文场景中全局 Top-K 选择带来的延迟瓶颈，我们为第 3.3 节中提出的层次化索引器（HI）实现了一个自定义算子。随后，我们在表 4 中对比了所提出的两阶段索引器（阶段 1 粗粒度页面召回，阶段 2 细粒度词元选择）与扁平 Lightning 索引器（LI）基线的执行延迟。

items.en: Our analysis reveals two distinct performance regimes. Below the recall budget (L ≤ 128K), Stage 2 still processes nearly the entire sequence and its latency scales with L. Consequently, the additional overhead of the two-stage design outweighs its benefits, resulting in a net slowdown of 0.79–0.82×. We therefore enable HI only beyond the crossover point (around 200K tokens in this setting), while falling back to the flat LI for shorter contexts. Beyond the recall budget, Stage 2 saturates at a constant latency of 27.8 ms, whereas the flat baseline continues to grow linearly with context length. As a result, the advantage of HI increases substantially with longer contexts, achieving 4.11× speedups at 1024K tokens.
items.zh: 我们的分析揭示了两种不同的性能区间。在召回预算以下（L ≤ 128K），阶段 2 仍处理几乎整个序列，其延迟随 L 线性增长。因此，两阶段设计的额外开销超过了其收益，导致净减速 0.79–0.82 倍。因此，我们仅在超过交叉点（本设置中约为 200K 词元）时才启用 HI，而对于较短的上下文则回退到扁平 LI。在召回预算之上，阶段 2 的延迟饱和在 27.8 毫秒的恒定值，而扁平基线则随上下文长度线性增长。因此，HI 的优势随上下文变长而显著增加，在 1024K 词元时实现了 4.11 倍的加速。

full.sec: 4.2 Attention Layer Training Speedup
full.secZh: 4.2 注意力层训练加速

items.en: We compare the training efficiency of LSA and DSA by measuring the forward and backward latency of a single attention layer across a spectrum of context lengths, reflecting practical production training setups.
items.zh: 我们通过测量单个注意力层在不同上下文长度下的前向和后向延迟来比较 LSA 和 DSA 的训练效率，这反映了实际生产训练设置。

items.capEn: Figure 4: Single-attention-layer training latency of LSA and DSA across context lengths. Bars report forward, backward, and total latency, including kernel execution and CP communication; arrows indicate LSA speedup over DSA. The CP degrees are 4, 8, 16, 32, and 128 for context lengths of 32K, 64K,

items.en: As shown in Fig.~4, LSA consistently reduces total attention-layer latency, achieving a \(1.53\times\) speedup at 32K and a \(1.61\times\) speedup at 1024K. Since HI is used only for inference, the training gains come from SI and CLI: (1) CLI reduces forward-only indexer overhead. By training a shared indexer across \(N=2\) layers through cross-layer distillation, CLI amortizes one indexer forward over two attention layers. Since this sharing does not reduce backward computation, CLI exclusively benefits the forward pass, with larger gains emerging at long contexts where indexer cost dominates. (2) SI accelerates both passes, especially backward. As shown in Section~4.1, SI improves both forward and backward efficiency by resolving the SFA backward write conflict. Since the backward pass is intrinsically more expensive than the forward pass, eliminating this bottleneck translates into a larger absolute saving and a stronger contribution to overall training throughput. Together, they deliver \(1.42\) – \(1.92\times\) forward speedup and \(1.34\) – \(1.55\times\) backward speedup.
items.zh: 如图 4 所示，LSA 持续降低注意力层的总延迟，在 32K 时实现\(1.53\times\)加速，在 1024K 时实现\(1.61\times\)加速。由于 HI 仅用于推理，训练收益来自 SI 和 CLI：(1) CLI 减少了仅前向的索引器开销。通过跨层蒸馏在\(N=2\)层之间训练共享索引器，CLI 将一次索引器前向分摊到两个注意力层上。由于这种共享不会减少反向计算，CLI 仅对前向传播有益，在索引器成本占主导的长上下文场景中收益更大。(2) SI 加速了两个传播过程，尤其是反向传播。如第 4.1 节所示，SI 通过解决 SFA 反向写冲突来提高前向和反向效率。由于反向传播本质上比前向传播更昂贵，消除这一瓶颈转化为更大的绝对节省和对整体训练吞吐量的更强贡献。两者结合，实现了\(1.42\) – \(1.92\times\)的前向加速和\(1.34\) – \(1.55\times\)的反向加速。

full.sec: 4.3 End-to-End Inference Speedup
full.secZh: 4.3 端到端推理加速

items.en: We compare the end-to-end inference efficiency of LSA and DSA at the LongCat-Flash-Lite (69B-A3B) model scale under representative prefill and decoding workloads.
items.zh: 我们在 LongCat-Flash-Lite（69B-A3B）模型规模下，针对具有代表性的预填充和解码工作负载，比较了 LSA 与 DSA 的端到端推理效率。

items.en: To support long-context inference, we use KV-cache Partition (KVP) to shard the KV cache across multiple ranks, alleviating per-device memory pressure. KVP is enabled for decoding at sequence lengths of at least 256K; detailed serving configurations and implementation are provided in Appendix B. We enable SI and CLI for all sequence lengths. HI is enabled only for prefill at sequence lengths of at least 256K, following the crossover point in Table 4. We disable HI during decoding because its two-stage overhead outweighs its benefit at short context lengths, while KVP reduces the per-rank KV length in the long-context regime where HI would otherwise be beneficial.
items.zh: 为支持长上下文推理，我们使用 KV 缓存分区（KVP）将 KV 缓存分片到多个 rank 上，以缓解每设备的内存压力。KVP 在序列长度至少为 256K 的解码阶段启用；详细的 serving 配置和实现在附录 B 中给出。我们对所有序列长度启用 SI 和 CLI。HI 仅在预填充阶段且序列长度至少为 256K 时启用，这与表 4 中的交叉点一致。在解码阶段我们禁用 HI，因为在短上下文长度下其两阶段开销超过收益，而在长上下文场景中 KVP 减少了每 rank 的 KV 长度，否则 HI 将是有益的。

items.capEn: Figure 5: End-to-end inference latency of LSA versus the DSA baseline: prefill time-to-first-token (TTFT, log scale) and decode time-per-output-token (TPOT) across context lengths. The arrow annotates the LSA speedup over DSA.

items.en: As shown in Fig. 5, LSA achieves a 1.42–3.60× prefill speedup and a 1.25–1.40× decode speedup over DSA. The prefill speedup increases with context length because the indexer accounts for a growing fraction of latency. Decode speedup peaks at 128K and decreases slightly at 256K and beyond, where the serving configuration switches to KVP. By sharding the KV cache, KVP reduces the indexer's per-rank workload and thus narrows LSA's relative advantage over DSA.
items.zh: 如图 5 所示，与 DSA 相比，LSA 实现了 1.42–3.60 倍的预填充加速和 1.25–1.40 倍的解码加速。预填充加速随上下文长度增加而增大，因为索引器在延迟中占用的比例越来越大。解码加速在 128K 时达到峰值，在 256K 及以上略有下降，此时 serving 配置切换到 KVP。通过分片 KV 缓存，KVP 减少了索引器的每 rank 工作负载，从而缩小了 LSA 相对于 DSA 的优势。

items.en: SFA scales as \(\mathcal{O}(LK)\) in prefill and \(\mathcal{O}(K)\) in decoding, whereas the indexer scales as \(\mathcal{O}(L^{2})\) and \(\mathcal{O}(L)\), respectively. The indexer therefore accounts for an increasing fraction of latency as the context length grows. At short context lengths, SFA dominates and most of the gain comes from SI. At long context lengths, the indexer dominates. CLI reduces its cost by reusing indices across layers, while HI mitigates its super-linear prefill scaling beyond 256K.
items.zh: SFA 在预填充中的复杂度为 \(\mathcal{O}(LK)\)，在解码中为 \(\mathcal{O}(K)\)，而索引器的复杂度分别为 \(\mathcal{O}(L^{2})\) 和 \(\mathcal{O}(L)\)。因此，随着上下文长度的增长，索引器在延迟中占用的比例越来越大。在短上下文长度下，SFA 占主导，大部分收益来自 SI。在长上下文长度下，索引器占主导。CLI 通过跨层复用索引来降低其成本，而 HI 则缓解了 256K 以上预填充的超线性扩展。

items.en: KV-cache offloading complements KVP by storing the cache in host memory and transferring only the chunks accessed by sparse attention. Its efficiency depends on temporal locality across decoding steps. SI improves this locality by reserving half of the attention budget for contiguous sink and sliding-window regions, increasing the average inter-step chunk overlap from 65.05% to 82.04% and reducing per-layer reload latency from 53.88 μs to 30.46 μs. CLI further enables asynchronous prefetching for index-reuse layers, reducing the visible latency to 15.23 μs, or 28% of the DSA baseline.
items.zh: KV 缓存卸载通过将缓存存储在主机内存中并仅传输稀疏注意力访问的块来补充 KVP。其效率取决于解码步骤间的时间局部性。SI 通过将一半的注意力预算保留给连续的 sink 和滑动窗口区域来改善这种局部性，将平均跨步块重叠率从 65.05% 提高到 82.04%，并将每层重载延迟从 53.88 μs 降低到 30.46 μs。CLI 进一步为索引复用层启用异步预取，将可见延迟降低到 15.23 μs，即 DSA 基线的 28%。

items.en: CLI also allows the three MTP steps used for speculative decoding to reuse the indices produced by a single indexer invocation (Section 3.2). Since draft tokens are verified by the main model, changes in draft quality affect acceptance length rather than final generation quality. As shown in Table 5, LSA achieves an average acceptance length of 3.11, compared with 3.15 for dense MLA. The difference indicates negligible impact on speculative-decoding efficiency.
items.zh: CLI 还允许用于投机解码的三个 MTP 步骤重用单次索引器调用产生的索引（见第 3.2 节）。由于草稿 token 由主模型验证，草稿质量的变化影响接受长度而非最终生成质量。如表 5 所示，LSA 的平均接受长度为 3.11，而密集 MLA 为 3.15。这一差异表明对投机解码效率的影响可忽略不计。

full.sec: 5.1 Setup
full.secZh: 5.1 实验设置

items.en: We validate the effectiveness of LongCat Sparse Attention (LSA) on two model scales from the LongCat family: LongCat-Flash-Lite (69B-A3B) and LongCat-Flash (560B-A27B). Both adopt the shortcut-connected MoE architecture with Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA). LongCat-Flash-Lite contains 14 shortcut layers (each with two serial attention operations, yielding 28 attention layers total) with 32 attention heads; LongCat-Flash consists of 28 shortcut layers (56 attention layers total) with 64 attention heads. We evaluate three attention configurations: (1) MLA: the standard Multi-head Latent Attention baseline with no sparsity; (2) DSA: the standard DeepSeek Sparse Attention with \(K=2048\) ; and (3) LSA: our proposed method with total \(K=2048\) , of which sink \(K_{\text{sink}}=16\) and window \(K_{\text{swa}}=1024\) are fixed, combined with hierarchical indexing and cross-layer indexing ( \(N=2\) ). For LongCat-Flash, we only compare LSA with MLA due to its larger scale and training resource constraints. Detailed model configurations are listed in Table 6.
items.zh: 我们在 LongCat 系列的两个模型规模上验证了 LongCat 稀疏注意力（LSA）的有效性：LongCat-Flash-Lite（69B-A3B）和 LongCat-Flash（560B-A27B）。两者均采用带捷径连接的 MoE 架构，并配备多头潜在注意力（MLA）。LongCat-Flash-Lite 包含 14 个捷径层（每层含两次串行注意力操作，共 28 个注意力层），32 个注意力头；LongCat-Flash 包含 28 个捷径层（共 56 个注意力层），64 个注意力头。我们评估了三种注意力配置：（1）MLA：标准的多头潜在注意力基线，无稀疏性；（2）DSA：标准的 DeepSeek 稀疏注意力，\(K=2048\)；（3）LSA：我们提出的方法，总 \(K=2048\)，其中固定 sink \(K_{\text{sink}}=16\) 和窗口 \(K_{\text{swa}}=1024\)，并结合分层索引和跨层索引（\(N=2\)）。对于 LongCat-Flash，由于其规模更大且训练资源受限，我们仅将 LSA 与 MLA 进行比较。详细模型配置见表 6。

items.en: Starting from mid-training checkpoints, we extend the context window through a two-stage long-context training process. LongCat-Flash-Lite is trained for 100B tokens at 128K followed by 100B tokens at 512K, while LongCat-Flash is trained for 100B tokens at 128K followed by 20B tokens at 256K. We convert MLA checkpoints to DSA and LSA during the final one-third of long-context training (512K for LongCat-Flash-Lite and 128K for LongCat-Flash), a transition that begins with a 1,000-step warm-up (7.5B tokens) before entering full sparse training. Ablations (Section 5.3.6) show that the conversion point has no measurable impact on final performance, and the chosen points are primarily for training efficiency. After long-context training, both models undergo supervised fine-tuning with the same settings as their corresponding technical reports.
items.zh: 从中期训练检查点开始，我们通过两阶段长上下文训练过程扩展上下文窗口。LongCat-Flash-Lite 在 128K 下训练 100B tokens，随后在 512K 下训练 100B tokens；LongCat-Flash 在 128K 下训练 100B tokens，随后在 256K 下训练 20B tokens。我们在长上下文训练的最后三分之一阶段（LongCat-Flash-Lite 为 512K，LongCat-Flash 为 128K）将 MLA 检查点转换为 DSA 和 LSA，该转换以 1,000 步预热（7.5B tokens）开始，然后进入完全稀疏训练。消融实验（第 5.3.6 节）表明，转换点对最终性能没有可测量的影响，所选点主要出于训练效率考虑。长上下文训练后，两个模型均采用与其相应技术报告相同的设置进行监督微调。

items.en: We evaluate across two capability groups:
items.zh: 我们评估两个能力组：

items.en: Long-context: for chat and thinking models we adopt HELMET, a comprehensive long-context benchmark covering Recall (RULER), RAG (HotpotQA + PopQA), Re-rank (MS MARCO), LongQA (NarrativeQA + \(\infty\) Bench), Citation (ALCE, with ASQA and QAMPARI), and Summarization (Multi-LexSum + \(\infty\) Bench). For base models, which we evaluate throughout our ablation studies (Section 5.3), we use the line retrieval task of LongEval, an \(n\) -shot needle-in-a-haystack task that we find effective for distinguishing base model quality.
items.zh: 长上下文：对于聊天和思考模型，我们采用 HELMET，这是一个全面的长上下文基准，涵盖召回（RULER）、RAG（HotpotQA + PopQA）、重排序（MS MARCO）、长问答（NarrativeQA + \(\infty\) Bench）、引用（ALCE，含 ASQA 和 QAMPARI）以及摘要（Multi-LexSum + \(\infty\) Bench）。对于基础模型（我们在消融研究（第 5.3 节）中全程评估），我们使用 LongEval 的行检索任务，这是一个 \(n\) 次射击的“大海捞针”任务，我们发现它能有效区分基础模型质量。

items.en: Overall: general capability is assessed with MMLU, MMLU-Pro, and CMMLU, C-Eval; reasoning with GPQA-Diamond, MATH500, and AIME 2024/2025; coding with HumanEval+, MBPP+ and LiveCodeBench.
items.zh: 总体：通用能力通过 MMLU、MMLU-Pro、CMMLU、C-Eval 评估；推理通过 GPQA-Diamond、MATH500 和 AIME 2024/2025 评估；编码通过 HumanEval+、MBPP+ 和 LiveCodeBench 评估。

full.sec: 5.3 Ablation Studies
full.secZh: 5.3 消融实验

items.en: All ablations are performed at the LongCat-Flash-Lite (69B-A3B) scale. LSA variants are compared with the MLA baseline through training/validation loss and Needle-in-a-Haystack evaluation, followed by HELMET evaluation after supervised fine-tuning.
items.zh: 所有消融实验均在 LongCat-Flash-Lite（69B-A3B）规模下进行。通过训练/验证损失和“大海捞针”评估，将 LSA 变体与 MLA 基线进行比较，并在监督微调后进行 HELMET 评估。

full.sec: 5.3.1 Streaming-Aware Indexing Preserves Quality with Half Fixed Budget
full.secZh: 5.3.1 流式感知索引在固定预算减半的情况下保持质量

items.capEn: Figure 6: Streaming-Aware Indexing ablation. “X% fixed” = fraction of budget KK allocated to the fixed window and sink tokens. (a) Training loss gap relative to MLA. (b) Validation loss on long-context set. (c) Needle-in-a-haystack retrieval accuracy.

items.en: A larger fixed window improves hardware efficiency through contiguous memory access, but reduces the tokens freely chosen by the indexer, risking degraded long-context modeling. We ablate this trade-off by varying the fraction of the total token budget \(K\) allocated to the fixed window (denoted “X% fixed”, including 16 sink tokens). Since long-context training is computationally expensive, we train MLA and DSA variants with different fixed ratios (0%, 25%, 50%, 75%, 100%) at 128K sequence length and compare their training dynamics and downstream quality. For brevity, we denote DSA with the standard Lightning Indexer as LI, and DSA with the Streaming-Aware Indexer as SI.
items.zh: 更大的固定窗口通过连续内存访问提高了硬件效率，但减少了索引器自由选择的令牌数量，可能导致长上下文建模质量下降。我们通过改变分配给固定窗口的总令牌预算 \(K\) 的比例（记为“X% fixed”，包含 16 个汇聚令牌）来消融这一权衡。由于长上下文训练计算成本高昂，我们在 128K 序列长度下训练了具有不同固定比例（0%、25%、50%、75%、100%）的 MLA 和 DSA 变体，并比较了它们的训练动态和下游质量。为简洁起见，我们将使用标准 Lightning 索引器的 DSA 记为 LI，使用流式感知索引器的 DSA 记为 SI。

items.en: Fig. 6 summarizes the results. Panel (a) plots each variant’s training loss gap relative to MLA: configurations at 75% fixed or below show negligible difference throughout training, whereas 100% fixed (i.e., pure window attention) exhibits a significantly higher loss. Panel (b) shows validation loss on a long-context set, where 100% fixed again shows significantly higher loss and was therefore abandoned. Panel (c) reports needle-in-a-haystack evaluation (LongEval line retrieval task, which we find discriminative for base models) on final checkpoints: at 128K context, 75% fixed suffers a clear accuracy drop while 0%–50% fixed all match or slightly exceed MLA. We therefore discard the 75% setting and apply supervised fine-tuning to the remaining groups. Table 9 evaluates the resulting chat models on HELMET: SI (50% fixed) achieves comparable performance to both LI (0% fixed) and MLA. We select 50% fixed (a \(\sim\) 1:1 fixed-to-dynamic ratio) as the default, as it maximizes the fixed window size without degrading long-context quality.
items.zh: 图 6 总结了结果。面板(a)绘制了各变体相对于 MLA 的训练损失差距：固定比例在 75%及以下的配置在整个训练过程中差异可忽略不计，而 100%固定（即纯窗口注意力）则表现出显著更高的损失。面板(b)显示了长上下文集上的验证损失，其中 100%固定再次表现出显著更高的损失，因此被放弃。面板(c)报告了最终检查点上的大海捞针评估（LongEval 行检索任务，我们发现该任务对基础模型具有区分度）：在 128K 上下文下，75%固定出现明显的准确率下降，而 0%–50%固定均与 MLA 相当或略优。因此，我们放弃了 75%的设置，并对剩余组应用监督微调。表 9 在 HELMET 上评估了生成的聊天模型：SI（50%固定）达到了与 LI（0%固定）和 MLA 相当的性能。我们选择 50%固定（约 1:1 的固定与动态比例）作为默认设置，因为它在不降低长上下文质量的情况下最大化了固定窗口大小。

full.sec: 5.3.2 Cross-Layer Sharing Preserves Quality Up to N=2N{=}2
full.secZh: 5.3.2 跨层共享在 N=2 时保持质量

items.capEn: Figure 7: Cross-Layer Indexing ablation (base models). (a) Training loss gap relative to MLA. (b) Long-context validation loss. (c) Needle-in-a-haystack retrieval accuracy across context lengths.

items.en: We study the impact of CLI group size \(N\) under uniform layer partitioning. Increasing \(N\) reduces indexer computation by allowing more layers to share one indexer, but also makes the shared indexer responsible for a broader range of layer-wise saliency patterns. Following Section 5.3.1, we train all variants at 128K sequence length and compare MLA against DSA with CLI group sizes \(N \in \{1,2,4\}\), where \(N=1\) corresponds to the standard Lightning Indexer (LI). To examine whether a larger selection budget can compensate for more aggressive sharing, we additionally evaluate \(N=4\) with the top-\(k\) budget increased from 2K to 4K. We denote DSA with the standard indexer as LI and DSA with CLI as CLI; unless specified otherwise, all variants use the default top-\(k\) budget of 2K.
items.zh: 我们研究了在均匀层划分下 CLI 组大小 \(N\) 的影响。增大 \(N\) 允许更多层共享一个索引器，从而减少索引器计算量，但也使得共享索引器需要处理更广泛的逐层显著性模式。沿用第 5.3.1 节，我们在 128K 序列长度下训练所有变体，并将 MLA 与采用 CLI 组大小 \(N \in \{1,2,4\}\) 的 DSA 进行比较，其中 \(N=1\) 对应标准 Lightning Indexer（LI）。为了检验更大的选择预算是否能补偿更激进的共享，我们额外评估了 \(N=4\) 且 top-\(k\) 预算从 2K 增加到 4K 的情况。我们将使用标准索引器的 DSA 记为 LI，使用 CLI 的 DSA 记为 CLI；除非另有说明，所有变体均使用默认的 top-\(k\) 预算 2K。

items.en: Fig. 7 summarizes the training and evaluation results. Panel (a) shows the training loss gap relative to MLA. Although CLI (\(N=4\)) exhibits a slightly larger gap, the final difference remains below 0.002 in absolute loss (less than 0.5% relative to the overall loss), suggesting that training loss alone is insufficient to capture long-context quality. This is likely because the variable-length training mixture contains many short sequences where sparse indexing differences have limited impact.
items.zh: 图 7 总结了训练和评估结果。面板 (a) 显示了相对于 MLA 的训练损失差距。尽管 CLI（\(N=4\)）表现出略大的差距，但最终绝对损失差异仍低于 0.002（相对于总损失小于 0.5%），这表明仅凭训练损失不足以反映长上下文质量。这可能是因为变长训练混合数据中包含许多短序列，其中稀疏索引差异的影响有限。

items.en: Panel (b) evaluates validation loss on a long-context set. While the curves show some variance, \(N=4\) consistently underperforms at the end of training, and increasing the top-\(k\) budget to 4K fails to recover the degradation. This indicates that the challenge of sharing one indexer across four layers cannot be addressed simply by expanding the selection budget.
items.zh: 面板 (b) 在长上下文集上评估验证损失。虽然曲线存在一定波动，但 \(N=4\) 在训练结束时始终表现不佳，且将 top-\(k\) 预算增加到 4K 也无法恢复性能。这表明跨四层共享一个索引器的挑战不能简单地通过扩大选择预算来解决。

items.en: Panel (c) evaluates the final base-model checkpoints using needle-in-a-haystack retrieval (omitting the \(N=4\), topk=4k variant since its validation behavior is similar to \(N=4\)). Beyond 32K context, \(N=4\) suffers a clear accuracy degradation that grows with sequence length, whereas \(N=1\) and \(N=2\) remain comparable to or slightly better than MLA up to 128K.
items.zh: 面板 (c) 使用大海捞针检索评估最终基础模型检查点（省略 \(N=4\)、topk=4k 变体，因为其验证行为与 \(N=4\) 相似）。在 32K 上下文之外，\(N=4\) 出现明显的准确率下降，且随序列长度增加而加剧，而 \(N=1\) 和 \(N=2\) 在 128K 以内与 MLA 相当或略优。

items.en: Based on these results, we discard \(N=4\) and perform supervised fine-tuning on the remaining configurations. Table 10 shows that CLI (\(N=2\)) achieves comparable HELMET performance to both LI (\(N=1\)) and MLA, demonstrating that halving the number of indexer computations preserves long-context quality. We therefore adopt \(N=2\) as the default CLI group size.
items.zh: 基于这些结果，我们舍弃 \(N=4\)，并对其余配置进行监督微调。表 10 显示 CLI（\(N=2\)）在 HELMET 上取得了与 LI（\(N=1\)）和 MLA 相当的性能，表明将索引器计算量减半可保持长上下文质量。因此，我们采用 \(N=2\) 作为默认的 CLI 组大小。

full.sec: 5.3.3 Cross-Layer Distillation Is Essential for Index Reuse
full.secZh: 5.3.3 跨层蒸馏对索引复用至关重要

items.en: As shown in Fig. 3, adjacent layers exhibit substantial overlap in their salient token sets. This raises a key question: is such inherent inter-layer consistency sufficient for cross-layer index reuse, or is the cross-layer distillation loss (Section 3.2), which explicitly trains the owner indexer to serve multiple layers within a group, necessary?
items.zh: 如图 3 所示，相邻层在显著标记集合上表现出大量重叠。这引发了一个关键问题：这种固有的层间一致性是否足以支持跨层索引复用，还是必须依赖跨层蒸馏损失（第 3.2 节）——该损失显式训练所有者索引器以服务组内的多个层？

items.en: This ablation requires no additional training. Since the indexer input is detached from the model computation graph during training (Section 2.2), indexers at different layers are optimized independently. We therefore construct a “CLI (N=2) w/o cross-layer distill” variant by removing redundant indexers from a trained LI (N=1) model and sharing the remaining indexer across two layers at inference time.
items.zh: 该消融实验无需额外训练。由于训练期间索引器输入与模型计算图分离（第 2.2 节），不同层的索引器是独立优化的。因此，我们通过从训练好的 LI（N=1）模型中移除冗余索引器，并在推理时将剩余索引器共享给两层，构建了“CLI（N=2）无跨层蒸馏”变体。

items.en: We evaluate this variant on needle-in-a-haystack retrieval. As shown in Fig. 7(c), removing cross-layer distillation causes severe degradation at long contexts: accuracy drops to 70% at 128K, below both distilled CLI (N=4, 82%) and distilled CLI (N=2, 96%). These results show that naive index reuse is insufficient. Cross-layer distillation is essential because it explicitly trains the owner indexer to capture the joint saliency patterns of all layers in the group, rather than producing indices optimized for only a single layer.
items.zh: 我们在“大海捞针”检索任务上评估该变体。如图 7(c)所示，移除跨层蒸馏会导致长上下文场景下的严重性能下降：在 128K 处准确率降至 70%，低于蒸馏后的 CLI（N=4，82%）和蒸馏后的 CLI（N=2，96%）。这些结果表明，朴素的索引复用是不够的。跨层蒸馏至关重要，因为它显式训练所有者索引器捕获组内所有层的联合显著性模式，而非生成仅针对单层优化的索引。

full.sec: 5.3.4 CLI Extends to MTP Layers
full.secZh: 5.3.4 CLI 扩展到 MTP 层

items.capEn: Figure 8: MTP metrics delta (DSA w/ CLI −- MLA) for all 3 MTP steps. Accuracy and loss differences remain tightly centered around zero throughout training, confirming that CLI across MTP steps preserves prediction quality.

items.en: We validate our design in Section 3.2 by comparing MLA with 3-step MTP against DSA with CLI shared across all 3 MTP steps ( \(N{=}3\) ). Since MTP outputs are draft proposals verified by the main model, any degradation appears as reduced acceptance length. As shown in Fig. 8, after sparse training converges, the LM loss gap remains below \(10^{-3}\) and prediction accuracy differences stay within \(0.1\%\) across all MTP steps. Consistently, Table 5 shows nearly identical acceptance lengths between LSA and MLA across HumanEval, GSM8K, AIME, and MRCR ( \(3.11\) vs. \(3.15\) ). These results demonstrate that CLI reuse across MTP steps preserves draft quality while eliminating redundant indexer computation.
items.zh: 我们在第 3.2 节中通过将 MLA 与 3 步 MTP 和 DSA（CLI 在所有 3 个 MTP 步骤中共享）进行比较来验证我们的设计（\(N{=}3\)）。由于 MTP 输出是由主模型验证的草稿提案，任何性能下降都会表现为接受长度减少。如图 8 所示，在稀疏训练收敛后，LM 损失差距保持在 \(10^{-3}\) 以下，且所有 MTP 步骤的预测准确率差异保持在 \(0.1\%\) 以内。一致地，表 5 显示 LSA 和 MLA 在 HumanEval、GSM8K、AIME 和 MRCR 上的接受长度几乎相同（\(3.11\) 对比 \(3.15\)）。这些结果表明，跨 MTP 步骤重用 CLI 在保持草稿质量的同时，消除了冗余的索引器计算。

full.sec: 5.3.5 Hierarchical Indexing Preserves Quality with Proper Configuration
full.secZh: 5.3.5 分层索引在适当配置下保持质量

items.en: Hierarchical Indexing is training-free (Section 3.3): it is applied purely at inference time and introduces no change to the trained model. Its only quality risk is insufficient coarse-stage recall, which the fine stage cannot recover. In this section we ablate the three knobs that govern this approximation—the pooling method, which indexer layers it is applied to, and the coarse-level recall budget—to identify the configuration that minimizes quality loss while retaining its speedup.
items.zh: 分层索引（Hierarchical Indexing）是免训练的（第 3.3 节）：它纯粹在推理时应用，不改变已训练的模型。其唯一的质量风险是粗粒度阶段的召回不足，而细粒度阶段无法弥补。在本节中，我们消融控制该近似的三个旋钮——池化方法、应用于哪些索引器层以及粗粒度召回预算——以确定在保持加速的同时最小化质量损失的配置。

items.en: The previous work AsyncTLS applied max-pooling to compute the block-level score, and the concurrent work HISA also suggests max-pooling as a future direction; we compared the mean pooling to the max-pooling option. Specifically, instead of the mean-pooled dot product \(\mathbf{q}_{t,j}^{I}\cdot\mathbf{k}_{n}^{\text{mean}}\) in Eq. 9, for each sub-block \(n\) we precompute the per-dimension extrema of its constituent keys, \(k_{n,d}^{\max}=\max_{s\in\text{sub-block}_{n}}k_{s,d}^{I}\) and \(k_{n,d}^{\min}=\min_{s\in\text{sub-block}_{n}}k_{s,d}^{I}\) , and replace the ReLU argument with a block-level score that upper-bounds the maximum token score within that sub-block:
items.zh: 先前的工作 AsyncTLS 采用最大池化来计算块级分数，同期工作 HISA 也建议将最大池化作为未来方向；我们比较了均值池化与最大池化选项。具体来说，在式(9)中，我们不用均值池化的点积 \(\mathbf{q}_{t,j}^{I}\cdot\mathbf{k}_{n}^{\text{mean}}\) ，而是为每个子块 \(n\) 预计算其组成键的逐维极值，即 \(k_{n,d}^{\max}=\max_{s\in\text{sub-block}_{n}}k_{s,d}^{I}\) 和 \(k_{n,d}^{\min}=\min_{s\in\text{sub-block}_{n}}k_{s,d}^{I}\) ，并用一个块级分数替换 ReLU 的参数，该分数是该子块内最大 token 分数的上界：

items.en: where \(D\) is the indexer head dimension, so the coarse score becomes \(I_{t,p}^{\text{page}}=\sum_{j=1}^{H^{I}}w_{t,j}^{I}\sum_{n=1}^{N}\mathrm{ReLU}(\tilde{s}_{t,n,j})\) . We conduct ablation studies for the pooling method across different pooling sizes under the NIAH 128K task. Mean pooling with a pooling size of 8 is the optimal choice, considering the effectiveness-efficiency tradeoff, as shown in Table 11.
items.zh: 其中 \(D\) 是索引器头的维度，因此粗粒度分数变为 \(I_{t,p}^{\text{page}}=\sum_{j=1}^{H^{I}}w_{t,j}^{I}\sum_{n=1}^{N}\mathrm{ReLU}(\tilde{s}_{t,n,j})\) 。我们在 NIAH 128K 任务上对不同池化大小下的池化方法进行了消融研究。考虑到效果与效率的权衡，池化大小为 8 的均值池化是最优选择，如表 11 所示。

items.en: We conduct ablation studies to choose which indexer to turn off the HI. The ablation shows that the shallow layers are more sensitive to the possible recalling error introduced by the HI. The final choice is to turn off the first 4 indexers to help preserve the model performance, as shown in Table 12.
items.zh: 我们进行了消融研究，以选择关闭哪些索引器的 HI。消融结果表明，浅层对 HI 引入的可能召回错误更为敏感。最终选择关闭前 4 个索引器以帮助保持模型性能，如表 12 所示。

items.en: To determine the recall pages of the coarse-level indexer of HI, we compared the performance of the different recall numbers in Table 13. Recalling \(M=1024\) pages is the boundary choice to preserve the performance in the MRCR tasks.
items.zh: 为了确定 HI 粗粒度索引器的召回页数，我们在表 13 中比较了不同召回数量的性能。召回 \(M=1024\) 页是在 MRCR 任务中保持性能的边界选择。

items.en: Based on the results of the three ablation studies, to preserve lossless performance, the final optimal setting is the Mean pooling method with a pooling block size of 8, turning off HI for the first 4 indexers, and recalling \(M=1024\) pages ( \(128K\) tokens) for all long-context tasks with sequence lengths \(\geq 256\) K. At the operator level, HI under this optimal setting achieves up to a \(4.11\times\) indexer speedup over the baseline at 1024K (Table~4). We also conduct a comprehensive evaluation of the Hierarchical Indexer with this optimal setting across various long-context tasks with sequence lengths up to 1024K in Table~15.
items.zh: 基于三项消融研究的结果，为保持无损性能，最终的最优设置是：采用均值池化方法，池化块大小为 8，对前 4 个索引器关闭 HI，并对所有序列长度≥256K 的长上下文任务召回\(M=1024\)页（即\(128K\)个词元）。在算子层面，该最优设置下的 HI 在 1024K 长度上相比基线实现了高达\(4.11\times\)的索引器加速（见表 4）。我们还使用该最优设置对分层索引器进行了全面评估，覆盖了序列长度高达 1024K 的各种长上下文任务，结果见表 15。

full.sec: 5.3.6 LSA Is Robust to Conversion Timing
full.secZh: 5.3.6 LSA 对转换时机具有鲁棒性

items.capEn: Figure 9: Context-length extension ablation. (a) 128K-stage loss gap (LSA −- MLA). (b) 512K-stage loss gap (LSA −- MLA). (c) SFT loss gap (LSA −- MLA). Values near zero indicate negligible quality difference.

items.en: Following standard practice, LSA is converted from a well-trained MLA model during long-context extension. Since LSA outpaces MLA beyond \({\sim}128\) K (Appendix A), throughput-optimal training dictates converting at 128K and remaining sparse thereafter. However, prior works defer conversion to the final extension stage. We hypothesize this stems from indexer distribution shifts: in sparse training, the KL loss supervision couples to the indexer's own top- \(K\) token selection ( \(\mathcal{S}_{t}\) , Eq. 5). Abrupt context-length transitions force the indexer through out-of-distribution shifts, potentially degrading supervision quality if converted too early.
items.zh: 遵循标准实践，LSA 在长上下文扩展期间从训练良好的 MLA 模型转换而来。由于 LSA 在超过约 128K 的上下文长度时优于 MLA（附录 A），吞吐量最优的训练要求在第 128K 阶段转换并此后保持稀疏。然而，先前的工作将转换推迟到最终扩展阶段。我们假设这源于索引器分布偏移：在稀疏训练中，KL 损失监督与索引器自身的 top-K 词元选择（\(\mathcal{S}_{t}\)，公式 5）耦合。突然的上下文长度转换迫使索引器经历分布外偏移，如果过早转换，可能会降低监督质量。

items.en: To verify whether the conversion timing affects quality, we compare two schedules on LongCat-Flash-Lite: (1) LSA (128K start), which converts from MLA to LSA at the very beginning of the 128K stage (100B tokens) and then completes the entire 512K stage (100B tokens) in sparse mode; and (2) LSA (512K late), which keeps full MLA throughout the 128K stage and converts to LSA only in the final third of the 512K stage—following the standard late-conversion recipe above.
items.zh: 为了验证转换时机是否影响质量，我们在 LongCat-Flash-Lite 上比较了两种调度方案：（1）LSA（128K 开始），在 128K 阶段一开始就从 MLA 转换为 LSA（100B 词元），然后以稀疏模式完成整个 512K 阶段（100B 词元）；（2）LSA（512K 晚转换），在整个 128K 阶段保持完整的 MLA，仅在 512K 阶段的最后三分之一转换为 LSA——遵循上述标准的晚转换方案。

items.en: As shown in Fig. 9, while the late-conversion schedule maintains a slightly tighter pre-training loss gap relative to MLA, both schedules keep this gap strictly below \(0.01\) throughout ( \(<0.5\%\) of the absolute loss, \({\sim}2\) ), and the SFT loss gap is centered at zero. Downstream evaluation on HELMET (Table 14) confirms that early conversion achieves performance parity with both late conversion and full MLA (58.96 vs. 59.02 and 58.50, respectively). Since downstream performance is closely matched, we recommend converting to LSA as early as the 128K crossover stage to maximize training efficiency.
items.zh: 如图 9 所示，虽然晚转换调度相对于 MLA 保持了稍紧的预训练损失差距，但两种调度在整个过程中都将此差距严格保持在 0.01 以下（绝对损失的 <0.5%，约 2），且 SFT 损失差距以零为中心。在 HELMET 上的下游评估（表 14）证实，早转换实现了与晚转换和完整 MLA 的性能持平（分别为 58.96 对比 59.02 和 58.50）。由于下游性能非常接近，我们建议在 128K 交叉阶段尽早转换为 LSA，以最大化训练效率。

full.sec: 6 LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse
full.secZh: 6 LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse

items.en: Building on the techniques developed in this work, we introduce LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse, which integrates the full LSA recipe into LongCat-Flash-Lite. Compared with the previously released model with full attention, the new model replaces dense MLA with LSA for substantially improved inference efficiency, extends the native context length from 128K to 1M, achieves stronger agentic capabilities, and preserves strong reasoning and general-knowledge performance.
items.zh: 基于本工作开发的技术，我们推出了 LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse，它将完整的 LSA 方案集成到 LongCat-Flash-Lite 中。与之前发布的采用全注意力机制的模型相比，新模型用 LSA 替换了密集的 MLA，从而显著提升了推理效率，将原生上下文长度从 128K 扩展到 1M，实现了更强的智能体能力，并保持了强大的推理和通用知识性能。

full.sec: 6.1 Model Informations
full.secZh: 6.1 模型信息

items.en: The released model is based on LongCat-Flash-Lite (69B-A3B) and replaces dense MLA attention with LSA using the configuration validated in Section 5.1: a total attention budget of \(K=2048\) tokens, including \(K_{\text{sink}}=16\) sink tokens, \(K_{\text{swa}}=1024\) sliding-window tokens, and dynamically selected sparse tokens. The model uses Cross-Layer Indexing with group size \(N=2\), while Hierarchical Indexing is applied as a training-free inference optimization beyond its efficiency crossover point. We further integrate a 3-step MTP module for speculative decoding, where all MTP steps share one indexer through CLI (\(N=3\)).
items.zh: 发布的模型基于 LongCat-Flash-Lite（69B-A3B），并使用第 5.1 节验证的配置将密集 MLA 注意力替换为 LSA：总注意力预算为 \(K=2048\) 个 token，包括 \(K_{\text{sink}}=16\) 个 sink token、\(K_{\text{swa}}=1024\) 个滑动窗口 token 以及动态选择的稀疏 token。该模型使用组大小为 \(N=2\) 的跨层索引，而分层索引作为免训练的推理优化，在其效率交叉点之后应用。我们进一步集成了一个 3 步 MTP 模块用于投机解码，其中所有 MTP 步骤通过 CLI（\(N=3\)）共享一个索引器。

items.en: We extend LongCat-Flash-Lite’s long-context training pipeline through five stages: 32K, 64K, 128K, 256K, and 1M. Based on profiling and ablation studies, we convert dense MLA to LSA at the beginning of the 128K stage, followed by sparse training across the 128K, 256K, and 1M stages. The MTP module is introduced at the 32K stage and converted to LSA together with the main model at 128K. After long-context extension, the model undergoes supervised fine-tuning. Note that only Streaming-Aware Indexing and Cross-Layer Indexing participate in training; Hierarchical Indexing is training-free and applied only during inference.
items.zh: 我们将 LongCat-Flash-Lite 的长上下文训练流程扩展为五个阶段：32K、64K、128K、256K 和 1M。基于性能分析和消融研究，我们在 128K 阶段开始时将密集 MLA 转换为 LSA，随后在 128K、256K 和 1M 阶段进行稀疏训练。MTP 模块在 32K 阶段引入，并在 128K 阶段与主模型一起转换为 LSA。长上下文扩展后，模型进行监督微调。注意，只有流感知索引和跨层索引参与训练；分层索引是免训练的，仅在推理时应用。

full.sec: 6.2 Model Evaluation
full.secZh: 6.2 模型评估

items.en: We first evaluate long-context capabilities with and without HI (Table 15), followed by a comprehensive evaluation on agentic, general-knowledge, and reasoning tasks (Table 16). For clarity, in these comparisons, Lite-Dense denotes LongCat-Flash-Lite, while Lite-Sparse (w/o HI) and Lite-Sparse (w/ HI) denote the sparse variants evaluated without and with Hierarchical Indexing, respectively.
items.zh: 我们首先评估了有无 HI 的长上下文能力（表 15），随后对智能体式、通用知识和推理任务进行了全面评估（表 16）。为清晰起见，在这些比较中，Lite-Dense 表示 LongCat-Flash-Lite，而 Lite-Sparse（无 HI）和 Lite-Sparse（有 HI）分别表示在无和有层次索引（HI）情况下评估的稀疏变体。

items.en: We evaluate across four capability groups:
items.zh: 我们评估了四类能力：

items.en: Long-context: We adopt ATLAS, which unifies existing long-context benchmarks under a common length axis and evaluates them at 8K, 16K, 32K, 64K, 128K, 256K, 512K, and 1M tokens. The evaluation covers retrieval (MRCR 8-needle), aggregation (OOLong-Synth), multi-step reasoning (GraphWalks), question answering (LOFT-Text Retrieval), in-context learning (HELMET-ICL), code understanding (LongCodeQA), long-range memory (AMemBench-ACU), and holistic evaluation (LongBench-v2 and AA-LCR).
items.zh: 长上下文：我们采用 ATLAS，它在统一长度轴上整合了现有长上下文基准，并在 8K、16K、32K、64K、128K、256K、512K 和 1M token 上评估。评估涵盖检索（MRCR 8-needle）、聚合（OOLong-Synth）、多步推理（GraphWalks）、问答（LOFT-Text Retrieval）、上下文学习（HELMET-ICL）、代码理解（LongCodeQA）、长程记忆（AMemBench-ACU）以及整体评估（LongBench-v2 和 AA-LCR）。

full.sec: 7 Conclusion, Limitations, and Future Directions
full.secZh: 7 结论、局限性与未来方向

items.en: We presented LongCat Sparse Attention (LSA), a co-designed sparse-attention framework that addresses the inefficient memory access and high indexing overhead of DSA through three complementary mechanisms: Streaming-Aware Indexing, Cross-Layer Indexing, and Hierarchical Indexing. Evaluations at both model scales show that LSA achieves nearly lossless performance relative to full attention while delivering substantial training and inference speedups. The resulting training-efficiency gains make native training with context lengths of up to one million tokens practical and support the development of LongCat-2.0 (1.6T-A48B). To facilitate further research, we also release LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse (69B-A3B), an open-source model that integrates LSA into LongCat-Flash-Lite and incorporates an updated long-context training corpus.
items.zh: 我们提出了 LongCat 稀疏注意力（LSA），这是一个协同设计的稀疏注意力框架，通过三种互补机制解决了 DSA 的低效内存访问和高索引开销问题：流感知索引、跨层索引和分层索引。在两个模型规模上的评估表明，LSA 在相对于全注意力几乎无损的性能下，实现了显著的训练和推理加速。由此带来的训练效率提升使得原生训练长达一百万 token 的上下文长度变得可行，并支持了 LongCat-2.0（1.6T-A48B）的开发。为了促进进一步研究，我们还发布了 LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse（69B-A3B），这是一个开源模型，将 LSA 集成到 LongCat-Flash-Lite 中，并加入了更新的长上下文训练语料库。

items.en: A primary constraint of LSA is that while it substantially reduces attention computation, it leaves the total KV-cache footprint intact, as every token must still store a KV entry. Although KV-cache partitioning and host-memory offloading (Section 4.3) mitigate per-device memory pressure, they do not lower the aggregate storage overhead. A promising future direction is to combine LSA with complementary KV-cache compression paradigms. For instance, Cross-Layer Attention (CLA) shares KV states across layers to compress the cache along the depth dimension, whereas DeepSeek-V4’s Compressed Sparse Attention (CSA) achieves sequence-dimension compression via block-level sparse selection. Fusing LSA with these orthogonal techniques holds great potential for scaling long-context models that are simultaneously compute- and memory-efficient.
items.zh: LSA 的一个主要限制是，虽然它大幅减少了注意力计算，但总的 KV 缓存占用保持不变，因为每个 token 仍然需要存储一个 KV 条目。尽管 KV 缓存分区和主机内存卸载（第 4.3 节）缓解了每设备的内存压力，但并未降低总存储开销。一个有前景的未来方向是将 LSA 与互补的 KV 缓存压缩范式相结合。例如，跨层注意力（CLA）跨层共享 KV 状态，沿深度维度压缩缓存；而 DeepSeek-V4 的压缩稀疏注意力（CSA）通过块级稀疏选择实现序列维度压缩。将 LSA 与这些正交技术融合，对于扩展同时具备计算和内存效率的长上下文模型具有巨大潜力。
